verdict.rationale: Coach's Ticket Quality Score reviews 100% of AI and human conversations against your quality standards, with bad scores flagged (and refunded). Coach turns findings into fixes, either implementing improvements itself or suggesting them, and simulation batches with side-by-side comparisons validate each workflow change. Guardrail events also land in analytics for QA review. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detailed documentation of the failure-flagging and human review queue workflow.
